video_caption: In the video segment from 0:00 to 0:15, a bearded man wearing a black clerical cap, a black robe, and a necklace with a golden cross speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands. He holds a small, ornate golden cross, switching it between his left and right hands while speaking. The background is a blurred image of an empty church interior, featuring rows of wooden pews, a red carpet leading to a decorative altar area adorned with religious icons and carvings. In the top left corner, a yellow logo displays a question mark shaped like a lightbulb with a cross inside, accompanied by the text "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS — FROM AN APOSTOLIC FAITH". At the bottom of the screen, an overlay states, "Orthodox Icons: Are we worshipping graven images? Father Anthony Mourad".

In this video segment, a man with a dark beard and mustache, wearing a black cassock, a black kamilavka (clerical hat), and a necklace with a wooden cross, stands in front of a blurred background depicting the interior of a traditional church with wooden pews, a red carpet, and an ornate iconostasis. He actively gestures with his hands while speaking to the camera. Initially, he holds a thin, dark stick-like object in his right hand. Around 0:08, this changes to a small, golden cross, and by 0:12, he holds a small, white cross in his right hand and a small tablet in his left. Throughout the segment, a logo is visible in the top left corner featuring a yellow lightbulb with a white question mark and the text "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS - AN APOSTOLIC FAITH". From 0:06 onwards, the question "Are we worshiping graven/carved images?" is superimposed on the lower left of the screen, setting the topic for discussion.

A bearded man, dressed in a black clerical robe and cap, stands in front of a blurred church interior, featuring rows of wooden pews and an ornate altar, with a red carpet running down the aisle. He holds a small golden cross-like object in his right hand and a tablet in his left, actively gesturing as he speaks directly to the camera with a serious yet engaging expression. In the top left corner, a logo reads "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS" with a cross inside a question mark and the tagline "AN APOSTOLIC FAITH." A banner at the bottom displays social media handles and a website address: "WWW.COPTICORTHODOXANSWERS.ORG." As he speaks, text overlays appear: first, a quote from "Genesis 1:26 (NKJV)," which states, "And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness." This text then transitions to show the word "Image" followed by its Hebrew origin, "Hebrew: צֶלֶם ‘Tselem’," and Greek origin, "Greek: Εἰκόνα ‘Eikona’," explaining that the word 'Tselem' is the Hebrew word for image and 'Eikona' is the Greek word for image. Finally, two bullet points appear: "1 - Icons play an important role in Liturgical Expression" and "2 - Icon simply means Image," emphasizing the significance of icons in church services and their fundamental meaning as an image.

In a static mid-shot, a bearded man, dressed in a black cassock, cross necklace, and black clerical cap, stands in front of a blurred background of a church interior with wooden pews and a red-carpeted aisle leading to an ornate altar area. He holds a small golden cross in his right hand, gesturing subtly with it as he speaks directly to the camera, while his left hand holds a small black tablet. On the bottom left of the screen, two lines of white text are displayed: "1 - Icons play an important role in Liturgical Expression" and "2 - Icon simply means Image".

The video segment begins with an overhead shot of a person in a pink top painting a religious outline on a white board with a light brown wash, depicting figures, including Jesus, and circular elements at the bottom. As this painting progresses, two inset video frames appear: first, in the bottom left, showing hands meticulously painting a Coptic icon with gold and red colors on a dark background, featuring two haloed figures and a dove; second, in the bottom right, showing a man with glasses and a beard carefully detailing the face of Jesus on a large canvas or wall. At 0:14, the scene transitions to a full shot of a bearded man, wearing a black cassock, a black head covering, and a cross necklace, standing in a blurred church interior with wooden pews and a red carpet. He holds a small golden object in his right hand and a white tablet in his left, speaking directly to the camera with a slight smile, as a logo in the top left corner displays "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS" with a lightbulb icon (incorporating a cross and a question mark) and the tagline "AN APOSTOLIC FAITH".

In a well-lit church interior, a man with a dark beard, dressed in a black cassock and a round black cap, looks directly at the camera while speaking. He holds a small, ornate gold-colored cross in his right hand and a black tablet in his left hand, and wears a large, dark cross on a chain around his neck. Behind him, rows of light wooden pews line a red-carpeted aisle leading to a highly decorated altar or iconostasis in the background, featuring religious artwork and golden accents. In the upper left corner of the screen, a logo displays a yellow lightbulb with a white question mark and a black cross on top, with the text "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS" and "An Apostolic Faith" written below it.

The video features a man with a dark beard wearing a black robe, a black skullcap, and a prominent wooden cross around his neck. He holds a small golden object in his right hand and a black tablet in his left, gesturing as he speaks directly to the camera. Initially, he stands in front of a church interior with rows of wooden pews, a red carpet leading to an ornate altar, and pillars on the sides. At 0:15, the background changes to a serene landscape with a path leading towards three crosses on a distant hill under a sky full of clouds, while the church interior with the man in it is relegated to a small inset box in the bottom-left corner. Large white text appears on the main background, quoting: "And God spoke all these words, saying: ‘I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. “You shall have no other gods before Me. “You shall not make for yourself a carved image—any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth; you shall not bow down to them nor serve them. For I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God […].’” (Exodus 20:1-5 (NKJV)). A logo remains visible in the top-left corner throughout the segment, featuring a yellow question mark shaped like a lightbulb with a white cross inside, and the text "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS AN APOSTOLIC FAITH". The text on screen disappears at 0:48, and the background reverts to the church interior, with the man continuing to speak and gesture.

A bearded man, dressed in a black robe and cap with a large cross necklace, stands in front of a blurred background of an empty church interior featuring wooden pews, a red carpet, and an ornate altar or iconostasis. He is smiling and gesturing with his right hand, holding a small wooden cross-like object, while holding a tablet in his left hand. In the top left corner, a logo is visible: a yellow lightbulb with a white question mark inside, topped with a white cross, and the text "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS" and "AN APOSTOLIC FAITH". At 0:21, a list of four white bullet points appears on the left side of the screen against the blurred background: "1 - Icons play an important role in Liturgical Expression", "2 - Icon simply means Image", "3 - Icons reveal the experience & revelation of God through imagery", and "4 - God is concerned with pagan worship, not the use of imagery". The man continues to speak and gesture with his hands, holding the cross and tablet, as the text remains on screen until 0:50, after which it disappears, leaving only the logo and the man speaking.

In this video segment, a bearded man, dressed in black clerical robes with a black hat and a large silver cross necklace, stands in front of a blurred church interior. The church features rows of wooden pews, a red carpet leading to an ornate altar area adorned with icons. The man holds a golden, staff-like object in his right hand and a tablet in his left, gesturing with both as he speaks directly to the camera with an expressive demeanor. In the upper left corner, a logo is visible, depicting a yellow lightbulb with a black question mark inside, above the text "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS IN APOSTOLIC FAITH".

The video features a man with a dark beard, wearing a black clerical robe and head covering, visible in a smaller frame in the bottom left corner. He holds a tablet or book in his hands, reading from it and occasionally gesturing with his right hand as he speaks. The background behind him is a blurred image of what appears to be the interior of a church or cathedral, with religious artifacts and pews visible. The main portion of the screen displays a vibrant and serene landscape depicting a path leading towards a distant hill crowned with three crosses, set against a backdrop of a warm, cloudy sky that suggests either sunrise or sunset. Throughout the segment, white text overlays this landscape, presenting biblical scripture. Initially, the text reads: "Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying: "See, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah. And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship, to design artistic works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in cutting jewels for setting, in carving wood, and to work in all manner of workmanship." Around the 0:25 mark, this text transitions to another part of the same passage: "And I, indeed I, have appointed with him Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and I have put wisdom in the hearts of all the gifted artisans, that they may make all that I have commanded you [...]" Below this second excerpt, the scripture reference "(Exodus 31:1-6)" is displayed. A small black and white logo with a question mark is visible in the bottom left corner, positioned above the man's video frame.

In a video segment, a man with a dark beard and dark hair, wearing a black clerical robe and cap with a cross pendant, is seated, gesturing with his right hand while holding a tablet or book in his left. He appears to be speaking or explaining something, looking down at the tablet for reference. Behind him, the interior of a church or cathedral with pews is visible. The main background of the video displays a serene, ethereal sky filled with clouds, illuminated by a warm, golden light, possibly a sunrise or sunset. A winding path leads towards three distant crosses on a hill. Overlayed on this background are biblical verses. Initially, the text reads: "“Then all the gifted artisans among them who worked on the tabernacle made ten curtains woven of fine linen, and of blue, purple, and scarlet thread; with artistic designs of cherubim they made them.” (Exodus 36:8)". Around the 0:15 mark, this text smoothly transitions to: "“He [Bezalel] made two cherubim of beaten gold; he made them of one piece at the two ends of the mercy seat: one cherub at one end on this side, and the other cherub at the other end on that side. He made the cherubim at the two ends of one piece with the mercy seat. The cherubim spread out their wings above, and covered the mercy seat with their wings. They faced one another; the faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.” (Exodus 37: 7-9)". In the bottom left corner, a logo with a question mark is partially visible, stating "ASK ME ABOUT...".

In this segment, a bearded man wearing a black clerical robe and a skullcap stands against a blurred background of a church interior, featuring rows of wooden pews, a red carpet, and an ornate altar with an iconostasis. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with a small, gold-colored cross-like object in his right hand and holding a black tablet in his left. A logo on the upper left reads "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS - AN APOSTOLIC FAITH." Starting at 0:08, a list of six points appears progressively on the left side of the screen, articulating ideas about icons: "1 - Icons play an important role in Liturgical Expression," "2 - Icon simply means Image," "3 - Icons reveal the experience & revelation of God through imagery," "4 - God is concerned with pagan worship, not the use of imagery," "5 - It is God that commands the use of Imagery in the tabernacle," and "6 - God equips with talents those called to this work." The man maintains eye contact and uses expressive hand movements, emphasizing his points as the text appears and then disappears.

The video opens with a man speaking directly to the camera, identifiable by his dark beard, black clerical robe, black kamilavka, and a large golden cross pendant on a chain. He gestures with a small, ornate golden cross or censer in his right hand and holds a tablet in his left, with a serious yet engaging expression. In the upper left corner, a logo displays a yellow question mark inside a white lightbulb with a cross on top, and text reading "COPTIC ORTHODOX ANSWERS AN APOSTOLIC FAITH". The background is a blurred view of a church interior, featuring rows of empty wooden pews, a red carpet down the aisle, and a decorated altar area with icons. After he concludes his statement about addressing specific subjects in another video, the screen briefly turns black, then transitions to an end screen featuring a woman with curly dark hair, wearing a dark blue blazer and a silver pendant. She smiles and speaks to the camera against a patterned grey background. Social media handles for "@CopticAnswers" on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube, and "@CopticOrthodoxAnswers" on Instagram are displayed to her left. In the bottom right corner, a prominent red circular button with a white YouTube play icon and the text "SUBSCRIBE HERE" encourages viewers to subscribe, while two empty rectangular frames appear in the upper right, likely for suggested videos.
